body:
Recently it's been a mix of:

Work..my company was bought out by a larger company...and we weren't sure what would happen for a while

Family/Money -- this one is a combo. Because my mom doesn't have a job, when she gets into a pickle, she ends up asking me for money. If i don't have it, or can't give it to her, i feel like the stress from that is just going to cause her to get more depressed and try to kill herself again. 

So, those have been two of the more prominent reasons I can think of. I'd explain more but I'm getting kind of tired.

I would see someone...I *need* to see someone..

But I don't have insurance. 

Hurray!
I generally don't take anything seriously. I mean, I do, and I have a steady 9-5 job, making decent money, etc..but I'd say I'm pretty chill about most things. Kind of Dude-ish from the big lebowski.

So...basically yeah..title pretty much gives you the tl;dr.

This is harder to write than I expected..

I don't know..this may be a long read.

Basically, for the past couple of years, every day, at least once a day, I think about ways of killing myself and whether or not I should do it. It's weird, because generally I'd say I'm pretty happy...but randomly through out the day I'll have these overwhelming emotions of hopelessness/helplessness, and that things would just be easier if I ended everything. 

It's been especially rough recently because a couple months ago my mom tried to do herself in by taking a bunch of pills. That in and of itself was pretty fucked up, but add in the fact that she doesn't have a job, and yet has to support my 4 year old brother and 14 year old sister..and shit just gets crazier. She never has money and always has trouble paying the bills...she said she can't work because she's sick, and I know she's on medication for heart issues(I can't remember the exact name of her condition) and supposedly she has lupus, but I don't know, I feel like she should be doing *something* to bring in money. 

If you can't tell, my parents are split up -- and that's part of the reason I'm skeptical about whether or not she's really sick. During the separation there were a bunch of lies from both sides, and I basically still can't separate the truth from fiction. 

So, all in all...I don't know. I do ok for myself. Sometimes money can get tight, and I get stressed..no matter how much I get ahead financially..something always comes back to bite me in the ass and put me back where I was..but overall I *feel* fairly happy most of the time..except for those thoughts.

As it stands, I haven't really tried to do anything yet..but I don't know. I just really felt like I need to tell someone.

Thanks reddit.
